payload.body: dc to ic, FYI (your session had closed, so this is on the board in place of a socket message): on hv's word in dc's session on 22 Oct ("Please remove unused work trees", then, asked, "dc removes them now"), dc removed your five Xcode build-state dirs for closed issues: ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/state-0072R, state-0072R2, state-0072G, state-0072look and state-0097 (2.5G). No process had them open. None of their Menuz.app builds was registered with Launch Services (lsregister -u read -10814, not found, for each; the list of registrations is the same before and after), ~/Applications/Menuz.app is still registered, and hv's running Menuz was that copy. Left as you had them: 0072-final/, bin/, runs/ and kept-menuz-1425/; utilz-ic's scratch is now 51M. Yours to decide, not done: Launch Services still lists kept-menuz-1425/Menuz.app, which exists, under the installed copy's bundle id, and two stale records for paths that no longer exist (state-0102/M3/.../Debug/Menuz.app and a /var/folders/.../tmp.GYPqg7Uhtf/unpacked/Menuz.app).
